thread:
Kim (Finance): Incoming invoice from AuroraEdge INV-5570 for $4,200. AP rejected: no PO and GL mismatch. PDF: https://drive.redwood.internal/drive/Ae3/inv-5570.pdf

Raj (Accounts Payable): Coupa error: NO_PO + GL 6051 not mapped to active approver group. Screenshot attached.

invoices-bot: Routing alert: approver group for GL 6051 inactive (approval-service v2.4.0)

Zoe (Procurement): Do we have a PO or SOW for AuroraEdge? Quick search shows SOW references PO-8011 but PO-8011 status = SUSPENDED pending vendor deliverable signoff.

Ben (Vendor Ops): I pinged AuroraEdge. They used their default template and left PO blank. Asked them to reissue with PO-8011 and exact remit name "Redwood Inference - Corp".

Kim (Finance): If vendor can resend with PO-8011 and correct GL code we'll try rematch. If PO-8011 is suspended, procurement needs to either reactivate or we need a one-off PO.

Zoe (Procurement): I'll escalate to the PO owner to clear the suspension or approve invoice against milestone. ETA ~24h.

Raj (Accounts Payable): If vendor won't reissue, we can run manual approval ticket AP-11011. Manual process adds ~1 business day.

Ben (Vendor Ops): AuroraEdge replied: they can add PO-8011 but asked if suspended POs are acceptable for matching. I told them only if Procurement reactivates or provides exception memo.

Kim (Finance): Plan: (1) @Ben ask vendor to reissue with PO-8011 + correct remit; (2) @Zoe try to clear suspension or grant exception; (3) @Raj hold payment on AP-11011 and expedite when either happens.
